artifacts.summary: Five-phase plan adding a read-only, console-only scout-agent to core and a strategic-brief early-exit mode to /review, with the three lint-agent-contracts.sh exclusion entries, manifest/index registration, and one bounded deploy-headless.sh regeneration.

memory_candidates.content: A new read-only, console-only agent added under agent-system/extensions/*/agents/ must be registered in THREE curated exclusion arrays in scripts/lint/lint-agent-contracts.sh, not two: EXCLUDED_TERMINAL_STATUS_RELATIVE_PATHS (Check E, terminal-metadata status presence), EXCLUDED_ARTIFACTS_TEMPLATE_RELATIVE_PATHS (Check F, return-meta artifacts template), and CHECK_J_EXCLUDED_RELATIVE_PATHS (Check J, handoff-writing section). All three checks iterate enumerate_dispatchable_agents() unconditionally, so a new agent file is in scope the moment it exists and FAILs on contracts a console-only agent structurally cannot carry. code-reviewer-agent.md and roadmap-agent.md are already in all three and are the exact precedent. Separately: naming the file so it contains neither 'research' nor 'implementation' keeps it out of Check N's two forced-membership globs, and Checks C/G/H/L/M are curated inclusion lists that do not force membership. manifest.json's provides.agents entry is mandatory (check-extension-docs Rule J plus deploy copying), but routing_agents must NOT gain an entry for a non-lifecycle-phase agent.
